nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Ultra Light Fluid Face Sunscreen SPF 60

avis.texte: This sunscreen is super light and I like how quickly it absorbs but I don't find it very hydrating and this burns my eyes so bad. If my eyes get the slightest bit watery they will begin to burn even 9 hours after application. At least it lasts on the skin i guess. I think for almost $40 I can find something better for me.

avis.titre: Not good for darker skin tones.
avis.texte: Tried this new product to get a higher SPF than 50. Left a white cast and also very drying. I love the brand just not this product for my skin.

I have been an avid user of this sunscreen for YEARS. I used it as my base layer under makeup, and loved it. However, the last two bottles I've purchased have been massive disappointments. Now, the product causes a huge amount of pilling all over my face, so i cant use it under makeup anymore. Secondly, I've now gotten sunburned several times even after having a full face of this sunscreen on and only being in the sun less than the recommended times between reapply. Not sure if they changed their formula recently, but i will not be using this product anymore.
Left s white cast on my face. Def not for Black or Poc complexion
If actually bought this product a few times because I wanted to give it a shot because it had so many great reviews but for my personal skin it make me flake white every time.
My dermatologist highly recommended this sunscreen and I use it everyday!!! It's light weight and absorbs right into your skin!! A total must have item!!!

I've used anthelios sunscreen before and it was my favorite but this one leaves a bit of white cast after applying and the texture feels kinda oily although it absorbs over time. It also irritates my eyes while working out/sweating.

This has been my tried and true since 2019, and I believe it's what helped me keep my youthful appearance. I am now 30 but still get mistaken for much younger, also want to mention I have oily skin and tend to break out easily but this sunscreen has never given me issues. I will say it does sting the eyes if you're out and sweating so watch out for that. I don't wear makeup but it works well with concealer and blush underneath. A few times I noticed it will appear patchy if you don't moisturize the night before or beforehand, but it's been no issue since I moisturize routinely. Very grateful my friend introduced this to me years ago
I last used La roche posay sunscreen in 2022 and it worked okay for me then. But not this time. It piles leaving lines of white residue. I dont know what but something must have changed.

avis.titre: Awful smell and horrible white cast
avis.texte: I dont know how this sunscreen have so many positive reviews when the smell is horrid and really strong. Stings the eyes, leaves a whitecast and its not worth the price. Would not recommend
I love this sunscreen, it absorbs quick. Does not leave a noticeable white cast but it does peel if you put on too much. I do recommend it!

avis.titre: It works great but smells bad
avis.texte: It turns out I recently gave it 3 stars cuz i thought it peels but it turns out it was my moisturizer instead and this actually works great and doesn't peel. it just smells bad.

avis.titre: It smells horrible and it peels
avis.texte: It works but it peels no matter how I try to layer it. I used only the Roche-Posay products and it still peels.
It says matte finish and it definitely is that, which is the opposite problem I was having with a previous brand with being too greasy.

I've been using this sunscreen since 2023 and wearing daily. Each bottle lasts me solid a year. The only con is I have to wait a few minutes after applying moisturizer or it beads up and rubs off. When I wait for moisturizer to soak in it don't happen. I love the feel of this sunscreen. It don't burn my eyes and it looks good under makeup. It also doesn't bother any acne I have and never causes new breakouts. Even with the moisturizer thing I don't think I'll ever change products because it hits the mark in every other aspect.
I've used this for years and continue to repurchase. Super gentle and effective. Good for every day use

After I started using any Roche products my skin became super sensitive, I developed dermatitis. My dermatologist gave different treatments but none worked. My skin only got better after I stopped using any of the La Roche-Posay products.

avis.titre: This sunscreen is friendly for make up
avis.texte: When I applied sunscreen, it absorbed super quickly into my face and didn't leave any greasy residue. And guess what? My makeup stayed put all day!

I bought this product this morning. It was okay at first, but the second application caused a little sensitivity. I was washing my face and I felt buring around my eyes. When I put on moisturizer it was the same thing. I know it has to be this product as it is the only new product in my routine. BUYER BEWARE!
This must be intended only for no makeup or skincare days. I cannot apply this without it pilling really badly. It also doesnt have great packaging, it leaks really easily. I would not buy again.

I liked this sunscreen! I love that its lightweight and i can barely feel it when it's on my skin. The cons are that it's almost too lightweight and when my skin is drier, it feels almost drying. It's also not perfect under makeup, sometimes clings to the drying spots. Overall though, this was one of the better sunscreens I've tried!

I can use some of this and it looks like foundation! Evens out my skin tone with light coverage. I ADORE this product. I have oily skin and it gives a natural finish to my face. 0 breakouts! Never stop making this formula!!! I appreciate the different shades as well. As I am pale, it isn't yellow.

avis.titre: I retract my last review yall
avis.texte: I lied this was actually really good, i used too much hence why it left a white cast on me. A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY!!!! Black girl friendly!!!!!

avis.texte: I lied this was actually really good, i used too much hence why it left a white cast on me. A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY!!!! Black girl friendly!!!!!

avis.titre: I looked like I was cosplaying ashy
avis.texte: My dark skin babes, unless you wanna look ashy I really won't recommend this. Maybe it's supposed to blend or magically absorbed within a few minutes or something, but I look white. I was trying to gaslight myself a little bit, but my sister screamed when she saw my face saying girl you you're going out like that?? Yea that was all I needed. BUT I would say it's very lightweight and blend well on the skin. It just leaves a TERRIBLE whitecast. For my Caucasian/light skin babes you may like this.
I've used the UK bersion of this sunscreen and its amazing. But this US version is awful. Smells so strongly of alchol and pilled my other skincare
i don't even have sensitive skin and this sunscreen burned and pilled so bad. smells really strong too.

This stuff is very runny, and I wish it were more moisturizing. However, it's the only face sunscreen I've tried that absorbs well and doesn't leave me looking oily. It's also worked so far - I've worn this for several hikes and haven't burned. I also haven't had any issues with this running into my eyes.

avis.titre: Fair skin with skin cancer history
avis.texte: I started wearing this sunscreen after a skin cancer scare and removal. I recommend it to everyone I know. I notice a huge difference when I have to wear a different one. Nothing compares
This stuff pills so bad under certain moisturizers and when you reapply. Doesnt reapply well.

avis.titre: I LOVE La Roche-Posay Anthelios ultra Light  Face Sunscreen
avis.texte: I have used this facial sunscreen for a number of years. I especially like it's lightness, and it doesn't clog my pores.

Not oily! No smell. Leaves a light layer of white, but hardly noticeable—I still feel confident just wearing the sunscreen w/o makeup. Only burns my eyes after wearing it for 10+hours which is way better than most. Been using this sunscreen for at least 5 years no complaints.
Bottle leaks :( I can't travel with it which i hate. Otherwise it's an excellent product.

avis.titre: Gave me dark spots because it's flawed
avis.texte: I used maybe 6 bottles in the last couple of years, firmly believing La Roche fluid was a good choice. I work from home and live in San Diego, so we have good weather all year, nothing crazy hot or insanely sunny. Started noticing darker spots exactly where I put them the most, under my eyes and cheek, then I found out they don't protect at all. I am really sad because I trusted this brand when I started using acids and even having layers and layers of this sunscreen for my limited time outside, today I have uneven tone and it made me age where I feel most insecure. Gonna try Korean products to remove them and Elta has been an amazing switch so far.
product leaves a white cast and does not sit well on my skin (combination skin for reference). also dries really fast and is very flakey
I have been using this product daily, year round for years. It is light on your skin, but very effective It was recommended to me by my dermatologist.
Very lightweight and doesn't leave a white cast. Perfect for sensitive skin.
This sunscreen always pills or just makes my skin super dry. Even trying to let to dry for 10/15 minutes. Just bad.

Pros- The product blends out super well and leaves my skin feeling soft. Since wearing it, my blemishes and dark spots have reduced significantly. Cons- I usually use suncreen instead of primer but this product doesn't do a good job at leaving a good base for makeup. I recommend using a primer before applying makeup.
Very thin and runny but dries up fast. No white cast. Pills if skin is dry.

This gave a light coverage and sat well on my skin. It didn't make it feel heavy like other mineral spfs would make me feel. I personally didn't notice much of a difference in the sun probably because I never really tried to see a difference before

The Laroche Posey anthelios tinted mineral light fluid sunscreen is great. I love how it does not irritate my skin, it is SPF 40, it blends well with my skin and there is no fragrance. It is very lightweight so I'm able to do a minimal make up look with having the sunscreen underneath my make up. I also like how it is very compact so I'm able to travel with it and it not being over 3 ounces. Overall, this is a great product and I will continue to use it!

This sunscreen is thin. It doesn't hurt your eyes or leave a white overcast. Perfect to go on before makeup. I even used it later in the day when I was watching my son's soccer game. Best part is you are getting great coverage against the sun. This is extremely important as skin cancer is extremely prevalent.

I bought it last week, I still don't know how much it protects skin from sun, but I really love the texture and how it feels on my skin, you can use it under your makeup and musturizer it's very light and soft

This was good for my oily skin however it did leave a white cast. My skin tone is medium deep and after a few minites of really rubbing the product in, it still left a white cast. Additionally, it did make my eyes burn and water.

goes on slightly greasy but feels fine once it dries down. i'm prone to clogged pores + acne and this doesnt break me out at all. i like this product in the summer particularly if i'm not wearing makeup - otherwise i prefer a more hydrating sunscreen to prevent dry patches. it's not bad under makeup, but it doesn't do any favors either. this wouldn't be my daily sunscreen in the winter for the same reason. otherwise a fantastic product!

This is the first time i buy La roche posay in the US and let me tell you this one is different than the one they sell in Europe. Been using the ultra fluide sunscreen for over 6 years now because it absorbs well and doesn't leave a white cast. This leaves a shiny white cast. Fir reference i have combination to oily skin.

Ive never seen a chemical sunscreen that left a white cast before? Not only that but this product gets patchy and settles into creases not just undereyes but around the mouth too. It burns my eyes everytime I wear it which is normal for chemical sunscreens but the rest isnt! Im so disappointed ive tried way better for a quarter of the price

This sunscreen for real is top tier. It doesn't break out your skin, leaves no whitecast, doesn't leave you looking or feeling so oily. Over some time, I've seen slight improvements in my skin, such as less irritation and redness to my texture.

Ive repurchased this product three time and added my 4th bottle to my cart. I have oily to combination skin, acne prone, and sensitive. This leaves my skin with a nice glow but not greasy. It can be used under make up as well, which is a plus. I have no regrets. Only down side is the cap, after a while sunscreen gets there and pile up. I have also tried the 100 on for Texas heat and works just as great!

avis.titre: The Best I've Found so Far…
avis.texte: I like that it dries pretty nicely, slightly matte but still a hint dewy, but also that it doesnt budge~i am up close and personal with other people on my day job and i find that it doesnt sweat into and sting my eyes like a lot of face sunscreens do. If im outside for more than 3 hours during 9 am and 4 pm ill reapply as needed. I am light skinned, but i dont see that telltale "sunscreen" cast. Goes on pretty well underneath my foundation on pretty days. I like the applicator top and overall so far this is my favorite face sunscreen.
Does not blend well with skin and has burned my eyes. Regret buying this.

I bought this because I wanted a chemical sunscreen so I wouldn't spend forver blending it in like a mineral sunscreen. First, it applied well, minimal white cast, natural finish and it didnt break me out. HOWEVER, 6 hours later, my face turned red and started to burn. I am assuming is it from the chemical sunscreen because it has been the only new skincare product I've incorporated into my routine. I would say that this product is NOT for sensitive skin at all. If you dont have sensitive skin, then I recommend this product.
the best spf for me there is on the market. Lightweight, not greesy! doesn't cause breakouts as much! love it.
I love that it has no prone clogging ingredients, however its not dark skin friendly! Leaves a white cast ghost look. But besides that i like it. Smh
This stuff is amazing! Super liquidy, spreads thin, and feels like a very nice primer when dried. A little goes a long way, so this bottle should last several months.

I needed to start wearing sunscreen daily due to a medical condition, and settled on this one to try. Its the first one (out of ones ive used in previous years) that has become a staple in my skincare regimen. It doesnt dry out my skin or break it out, and wears well under makeup so much so I dont really wear primer anymore. It can take a but to adjust to how watery it is, and you have to pay attwntion when applying to make sure it doesnt leave any streaks. I feel that you definitely get your moneys worth in the bottle, as om still using the bottle I bought back in February.

I have very very sensitive skin and have searched high and low for a face sunscreen. This stuff is IT! I will not use anything else. It is so lightweight and makes my skin baby soft. Absolutley no whiteness left behind and covers 60 spf! I will be using this all summer, especially since I'm pregnant!
I wanted to love it im a sunscreen , skincare girly but it's horrendous i have pale skin and the cast it left was like casper waste of money

avis.titre: Favorite Sun Protection for my face!
avis.texte: Ultra light. Skin feels smooth after application. Does not turn white or smother your skin.

We got home from our bike ride, and when I looked in the mirror there was yellow caked into my eyebrows, around my hairline and splotchy on my face. At first I thought it was pollen, turns out it was the sunscreen. I guess it only happens to some people's skin. With all the good reviews, and the price, this was a disappointment for sure. I like this brand, but the sunscreen's not for me. Returned

avis.titre: Holy grail spf for sensitive acne prone skin!
avis.texte: I'm very picky when it comes to sunscreen since I have sensitive acne prone skin. A lot of them break me out and make me oily. They can be thick and hard to pair with other products or have a strong scent. This spf however doesn't have any of those issues! It truly marks all the boxes for me. It's super thin and liquidy. It pretty much blends itself. And leaves a dry to touch natural finish with no greasiness whatsoever. It doesn't irritate my eyes and looks great under makeup. You just have to make sure you shake it really, really well before application. It does seem a bit pricey but compared to other "drugstore" sunscreens you really get what you pay for. I consider this a drugstore luxury sunscreen lol it's also easy to reapply over makeup if needed.

I was looking all over for a daily face sunscreen that wouldn't leave a greasy feel on my skin, or have a pungent smell. Finally found it! This goes on nice and light, no greasy feeling, and no lingering sunscreeny scent. My dream sunscreen!

I tried loving this until I realized that it was causing break outs. I stopped using it and my face cleared up, I did try it one more time and it's definitely not for sensitive skin my skin kept reacting to it.
I have sensitive combination skin & bought this to wear under make up.
Very good product. Light and effective. I have used it a few times this winter.
This is not for us brownskin or deep skin tone it will leave a white cast

I am a sweaty girl when it comes to sunscreen, to the point where i avoid wearing because i hate how it makes me feel. This however, is light weight and runny but you can tell itll provide great coverage. I dont sweaty more than i usually would and forget i have it on. Downside is the price and the ounces u get. I have noticed that if im careless with the application it leaves a slight white cast but i just have to make sure to blend it in well. If you have deeper skin, be mindful of that

It works well in terms of texture. It doesn't feel oily, doesn't leave white cast, and blend well with my skin. The only thing I don't like about it was that after used, and removing it with cleanser, it seems to dry out my skin, making my skin itches at a certain spot. Weird. The tinted sunscreen from LRP, doesn't really do that to my skin, but this one does.
This sun screen is SO good! It's matte but not chalky and no white cast it also feels like an almost powdery finish its so soft!
Solid SPF not much of a white cast once rub in a 10 secs nice dewy finish

I love this brand, but this product in particular isn't my fave. I'm African American, light brown skin, and i ABSOLUTELY see a white cast. It's not as noticeable as some other brands, but it's there. I wouldn't buy this again just based on that.
I absolutely love it, it's super lightweight and great for oily skin
I love this stuff. It blends in easily, isnt greasy and feels light on the skin. It also leaves my incredibly oily skin with a natural finish. A++

I love all LP products, and is mostly what I use for all my skincare needs, however, the sunscreen fell way below expectations. First let me say that the color is great, my main complaint is that it stays greasy on me. I have even skin and this leaves me a little oily in my t zone, chin and forehead. If I could suggest an improvement? It would be to figure out how to have this sink into the skin and leave your skin "dry" not slick.

I've tried a lot of sunscreens and i was skeptical about this one, but it's perfect as part of my skincare routine. I have limited time to sit and wait for products to absorb so i can layer other produtcs in my morning routine, and this spf does not add tons of wait time. For ref, I use vitamin c, the la roche-posay toleraine double repair matte moisturizer, then this in the morning after washing with Cerave SA cleanser. No pilling. No greasy mess. No long absorbing time before I apply face primer. Works great.
I was looking for a long time a Sunscreen that works for my type of skin and for my extremely daily routine under the sun. Love it!

avis.titre: It peels with my favorite moisturizer
avis.texte: I do like this by itself, it's matte and is thin. It doesn't mix well with my moisturizer so it's a no for me.

avis.titre: Fussy to blend, otherwise cosmetically elegant!
avis.texte: I have dry, rosacea prone skin. PROS: Evens out redness on my skin, not super shiny. CONS: As others have mentioned this gets pilly and flaky depending on your previous skincare steps. I wear this to exercise and it gets heavy and hot feeling. Almost too expensive for what it is imo but worth a try!!

But i just couldnt. I tried several days but each time no matter what i did it just pilled terribly which added an additional 5 minutes to my morning routine. I did find it very lightweight and not oily which was nice, but couldnt get over the pilling.

feel like ive tried ten million SPF products but this is the best one. im an acne prone skin sensitive girly and this did not break me out at all :) no white cast, does not pill. It absorbs quickly into the skin. its super light weight and works well under makeup. it has a unique smell but personally i dont mind it. BUY IT!!

This is probably the only sunscreen that doesnt break me out and works effectively. I was under the sun for about 3 hours straight and didn't completely obliterated by it, thanks to la roche posay! I really wanna test out the spray version to see if it works well over my makeup. The only downside is that I did get some pilling after applying it on top of my moisturizer. I had to dust off the residue with a face towel and reapply spf to the affected areas. It's pretty easy to work with, but might be an issue if youre in a rush.

I live in SW Florida and finally realized the importance of wearing daily sunscreen (bit late at 33 🥴). I've tried Neutrogena, Elta MD and a couple others but this is by far my favorite. Natural/matte finish - not drying or greasy and zero white cast. Been wearing for 2 weeks now and no signs of breakouts. Also doesn't irritate my eyes at all which is nice. Seems to kind of even out my skin tone too when I wear it which is a nice bonus. I will absolutely be repurchasing this.

The mineral sunscreen makes your skin feel great while giving you full protection. I used it all summer while out on the lake, at the beach and playing sports. It protected me through all these. I did apply every 2 hours

I love love love this sunscreen! Blends into the skin nicely, no white tint, doesn't get too glowy or oily throughout the day (I have combination skin), and looks really nice under makeup. My skin sometimes gets sensitive too because of rosacea and this doesn't bother it.

This is an amazingly light sunscreen that goes on effortlessly. There is no residual whiteness. I love it. Originally my dermatologist had included a sample in a bag filled with samples from many different companies. This was my favorite.
The best sunscreen on the market and doesn't sting my eyes. Lightweight and easy to apply.

avis.titre: No residue, absorbed into skin immediately
avis.texte: Its hard to believe it is sunscreen. It disappears into your skin, leaving no sticky feeling, and you can use moisturizer and makeup right over it. Now i won't mind using sunscreen.
i got lrp's sunscreen for oily skin types, but it left white casting and didn't spread well at all. this is silky smooth and everything i wanted.
My eye area was so red after using it and burning really bad . It dries out my skin and pills .
It's very light on face and works great all day and mix well with the serum a great buy a must buy….

The best sunscreen at the market, it is so good for my aging, rosacea, oily and very sensitive skin , the ingredients on it are very good for my skin instead of zinc oxide and titanium dioxide that burn my skin
No matter how many ways i have tried to apply this, it doesnt absorb, leaves a white caste, and pills.
Good sun protection doesn't break your skin out or make you feel like you got oil all over your face like some products do. Not a bad scent. And seems to absorb into the skin well.

I enjoyed the smooth and creamy texture of the Lotion. It felt wonderful and absorbed quickly into my skin. It didn't leave a greasy feeling and honestly it smelled good but just like sunscreen. I would recommend this lotion, I enjoyed it.

The La Roche-Posay Anthelios Ultra Light Fluid Facial Sunscreen SPF 60 is unlike any other product that I've used before. It is super light weight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a greasy residue.
Very good non oily SPF 60 Sun block serum. I highly recommend it.
Sunscreen with good coverage, absorbs super easy to the skin and leaves you a good texture is non-greasy and has a very good essence, I recommend it helped me with acne!!
This product is a great way to be protected in the sun but also not make you look too white/pasty. No horrible scent, feels smooth on the face, absorbs lovely.

avis.titre: One of the best sunscreens I've ever used
avis.texte: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Ultra Light Fluid Facial Sunscreen SPF60 is a top-rated sunscreen. It's lightweight, non-greasy, and ideal for daily use, even on sensitive skin.

I have been looking online for a good facial sunscreen, and I decided to try this one. After trying it for the first time, I am really amazed with the texture of the sunscreen. It is NOT oily at all, easy to apply to face. good for daily wear w oily skin, apply moisturizer beforehand . I know the price seems a bit much, but trust me, this lasts a lot longer than it appears. This is the sunscreen I am looking for, will continue purchase!
My favorite everyday sunscreen. No white cast and not greasy at all. There's no strong scent and feels so light weight. Great for sensitive skin I'm on my third bottle and still going strong.

This is the best sunscreen I've ever used! Not only does it provided amazing sun protection, it blends into the skin beautifully and doesn't leave a white cast on my skin! It has a thin light weight formula perfect for every day use under make up or for hot beach days!

My favorite sunscreen ever!!!! I love this product so much you just seeps to your skin￼!! One of the only sunscreens I know that does not leave a white cast!!! It has the Laroche Posey thermal spring water and is water resistant￼!!! ￼
This one product that has never failed to amaze me. I've tried many of their lines but I'm in love with their sunscreen. Very very light on the skin and dissolves like magic.
Protects my face all day without feeling like I have sunscreen on. It blends beautifully under my makeup, isn't greasy, and I feel protected!!!
I really like it, it absorbs super quickly into the skin, it's not greasy at all, the texture is spectacular and it has no smell, it's just perfect.and offers very good protection from the sun's rays

avis.titre: Light weight and perfect for under foundation
avis.texte: My favorite daily sunscreen - it's light weight and dries so nicely. This is my go-to to ensure I don't get a thick build up of layers when I apply my foundation over my sunscreen.

My dermatologist recommended this product for me for daily use. I love it! Just enough coverage of skin flaws and it balances out my skin tone. Also I love the protection from the sun. I use it 365 days a year
It's good but greasy and my face shine, it's not dry touch or matte so when I use it I have to use finish powder to make that matte touch.

Very lightweight and moisturizing. Fragrance free and blends nicely without tacky or greasy feel. Didn't sting my eyes and easy to wash off. Absorbs pretty quickly and didn't leave any white cast. Love SPF 60!

I love this sunscreen so much. It's not too expensive but definitely on the higher end of most sunscreens. I am a strong believer in this sunscreen. It goes on so smoothly and whenever I reapply, it doesn't feel heavy or oily. I love this sunscreen so much I've already purchased 5 of this brand!
This has been my favorite sunscreen for years. Its non greasy, doesn't clog pores, doesn't have a white cast. It has helped prevent dark spots. No issues under makeup or reapplying
Love the spf and absolutely love the color of the product when it applies. Great for no makeup days, especially when hitting the sun. The brand of course is amazing.

"La Roche-Posay Anthelios Ultra Light Fluid is legit amazing! 🌞 It's super lightweight, non-greasy, and provides top-notch sun protection. ☀️ Your skin will thank you for using this holy grail sunscreen! 😍"
This is the sunscreen I will buy time after time! It is thin but feels so amazing when it sinks into the skin. The ball inside is satisfying too. A little pricey but worth it!

The product is just ok to me, but the prices is too high, there are some others that work the same and cheaper prices. I won't purchase again. I gave 4 stars for the quality, but for the price is maybe only 3 stars .
